title: Chapter 111 — The Store's Money: Margins, Costs, and The P&L
intro: How the store actually makes money and reading its health.

sections.title: Understand the Math
sections.content:
Every salesperson should understand the basic math of the business. Gross margin, operating expenses, payroll, marketing costs, and net profit.

Why? Because when you understand margins, you stop giving away profit unnecessarily. When you understand costs, you appreciate why attach rates matter. When you understand the P&L, you think like an owner — and owners make better decisions than employees.

You do not need to be a financial analyst. You need to understand that every dollar of margin you protect contributes to the business that pays your commission.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating financial literacy, ask:

Does the salesperson understand gross margin and how their sales contribute to it?
Do they protect margin — or give it away under pressure?
Do they understand the connection between attach rate and store profitability?
